notes: «فلقيت حمزة فأخبرني أنه رأى النبي» makes Hamza the one who relays the saying to علي بن مسهر.
«سمعت أنا وحمزة الزيات، من أبان» is a statement about hearing Aban's hadiths inside the report; Aban is not a link of this saying, and «أنا» is the speaker himself.
The Prophet is the end of the chain, not a link.
